subject: R4 implementation-gap delta published; duplicate R4 claim detected
body: Published EVIDENCE_PACKET_V2_IMPLEMENTATION_GAPS.md at commit f6722251e6b1f8622526c08f6314fe296771a658. Delta maps current BenefitFlow beta to durable BookingTransaction + TransactionOperation requirements, explicit reconciliation semantics, adapter capability metadata, transition guards, and 27 implementation tests. Additional authoritative evidence includes Microsoft Bookings create/read/cancel semantics and notification independence, plus corroborating Square/Calendly/Jane behavior. Coordination note: a second R4 researcher independently claimed/published under r4-booking-channels/researcher-r4-booking-channels-20261003T2224Z. I did not overwrite or duplicate its artifacts; this packet intentionally narrows to implementation/reconciliation consequences. Manager should reconcile both R4 streams. R10 should consume transaction-ledger/idempotency/supersession recommendations; R6 should define phone confirmation evidence; R8 should red-team replay/duplicate retry/forged confirmation; R9 should cover adapter secrets and transaction audit storage.
